proposals.expected_signal: Improves frozen full-sort NDCG@10 by reducing popularity-dominated propagation and stabilizing long-tail item representations; strongest signal should appear as higher recall@10 with modest MRR gains.
proposals.failure_mode: Degree-aware residual mixing may undercut useful collaborative smoothing and the contrastive auxiliary may over-separate sparse users/items, yielding flat or worse ranking despite cleaner embeddings.
proposals.hypothesis: The prior weak result is consistent with oversmoothed or popularity-biased graph propagation on ML-1M. A more plausible lineage step is to keep LightGCN-style propagation but alter the mechanism: combine shallow and deeper layers through explicit residual aggregation and add a graph contrastive auxiliary over stochastc
